title: Unpacking the Compute Efficiency of Strong-to-Weak OPD against GRPO
snippet: Multi-teacher OPD (DeepSeek-AI, 2026) consolidates per-domain GRPO experts into a single student that matches each expert's accuracy, with the distillation stage costing only 5.2% (on 2 domains) and 8.0% (on 4 domains) of the specialist training FLOPs.

title: U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela in July were highest since 2017
snippet: Energy Information Administration, Petroleum Supply Monthly In July 2026, U.S. imports of crude oil from Venezuela averaged 701,000 barrels per day (b/d), the most since May 2017, before decreasing to 655,000 b/d in August, according to data published in our Petroleum Supply Monthly.
